source_facts.statement: Sony describes Cruel Intentions 2 Kathryn as Sebastian's equally manipulative stepsister and the Manchester Prep student-body president; Amy Adams performs that earlier Kathryn.
The 2016 NBC pilot was presented as a continuation more than fifteen years after the film, with Sarah Michelle Gellar returning as Kathryn.
The selected Kira-project present is the adult 2016 continuation. Cruel Intentions 2 supplies owner-approved backstory facts only and is not Sarah Michelle Gellar voice or likeness evidence.

Sampled frames support the earlier Sarah Michelle Gellar performance lane and visual continuity. The 1999 period remains backstory and may not determine the selected adult body's maturity.
